meta.description: Registry for provisional stability metrics, perturbation classes, and boundedness criteria in Phase 2 of the Mono-Process Formal Law Program.

stability_metrics.name: branch_growth_rate
stability_metrics.meaning: Rate of admissible branch proliferation under recursive continuation.

stability_metrics.name: residue_drift
stability_metrics.meaning: Deviation of residue-state equivalence under iterative update.

stability_metrics.name: orientation_deviation
stability_metrics.meaning: Accumulated orientation mismatch under recursive transport/composition.

stability_metrics.name: projection_collapse_rate
stability_metrics.meaning: Rate at which equivalence collapse reduces distinct admissible states.

stability_metrics.name: transport_closure_retention
stability_metrics.meaning: Degree to which admissibility neighborhoods remain closed under transport.

stability_metrics.name: reconstruction_ambiguity_growth
stability_metrics.meaning: Rate of preimage ambiguity expansion under recursion/composition.
